speaker: interviewer
text: Hi Daniel, thanks for joining. Is English OK? I know you prefer it.

speaker: interviewee
text: Yeah, English is easier for me for work stuff. Five years in Boston, it stuck.

speaker: interviewer
text: Great. So tell me a bit about yourself.

speaker: interviewee
text: I lead a team of eight at a SaaS company, mostly backend and some data. And I play FC, Ultimate Team, usually late at night after the kids are asleep.

speaker: interviewer
text: Great, great. How long have you used Claude Code?

speaker: interviewee
text: About a year. I use it for reviews mostly, and for my own little scripts. I don't code as much as I used to.

speaker: interviewer
text: And how did you hear about Claudictive?

speaker: interviewee
text: One of my engineers is in the beta. He showed it in a demo day thing we have on Thursdays.

speaker: interviewer
text: Great. How was the onboarding?

speaker: interviewee
text: Fine. It's Overwolf, so, you know, a bit bloated. But it worked first time.

speaker: interviewer
text: Anything confusing?

speaker: interviewee
text: The permissions screen. It asked for a lot of things and I wasn't sure why it needs all of them.

speaker: interviewer
text: Got it. Great. Let's move to the next question. How often do you use it?

speaker: interviewee
text: Honestly? Not much. Maybe twice in the last two weeks.

speaker: interviewer
text: And what did you do with it those times?

speaker: interviewee
text: I asked Claude to summarize a PR one of my guys opened. And once to check a failing deploy. Mostly it's while the game is loading, the loading in FC takes forever, so I'm already checking Slack on my phone anyway.

speaker: interviewer
text: Great. What features would you like to see?

speaker: interviewee
text: Hmm. Voice, probably. Everyone will say voice I guess.

speaker: interviewer
text: Yeah, we hear that a lot. Don't you think it would be amazing to just talk to Claude in the middle of a match?

speaker: interviewee
text: I mean... sure, it sounds cool. In FC the matches are pretty intense though.

speaker: interviewer
text: Great. Anything else?

speaker: interviewee
text: Maybe a smaller mode. Like just a status line, is my thing done or not.

speaker: interviewer
text: A status line, great, noted. What about themes?

speaker: interviewee
text: Don't care much. Dark is fine.

speaker: interviewer
text: Great. Let's move on. On a scale of one to ten, how much do you like the idea?

speaker: interviewee
text: The idea, eight. The execution right now, maybe six. It's beta, it's fine.

speaker: interviewer
text: What would make the execution a ten?

speaker: interviewee
text: Speed, mostly. Sometimes I hit the hotkey and nothing happens for a second or two.

speaker: interviewer
text: Got it, latency. Great. Would you pay for it?

speaker: interviewee
text: Me personally, maybe. Would I buy it for my team? Probably not, most of them don't game. Or they game but they wouldn't admit it to me.

speaker: interviewer
text: Haha. And how much would you pay?

speaker: interviewee
text: Five bucks a month, maybe. I pay for a lot of these little things and I forget about them.

speaker: interviewer
text: Great. Would you recommend it to a friend?

speaker: interviewee
text: Yeah, to a couple of people. There's a guy on my team who plays Apex every lunch break.

speaker: interviewer
text: Great, great. Do you use the notifications feature?

speaker: interviewee
text: The toast when a task finishes? Yeah, that's nice actually. I like that one.

speaker: interviewer
text: Great. And what did you dislike the most?

speaker: interviewee
text: The window is big. It covers most of the screen. And the font is kind of... default.

speaker: interviewer
text: Noted, window size. Great. Have you tried the mobile companion idea we mentioned in the beta email?

speaker: interviewee
text: No, I didn't see that email. What is it?

speaker: interviewer
text: It's an idea for an app on your phone that shows Claude's status. Would you use that?

speaker: interviewee
text: Maybe. I don't know. I already have Slack on my phone, and GitHub.

speaker: interviewer
text: Great. Let's move to the last few questions. Is there any feature you think is missing compared to the terminal?

speaker: interviewee
text: Seeing diffs. In the overlay you only see text. I want to see what changed.

speaker: interviewer
text: Diffs, great. Anything you'd remove?

speaker: interviewee
text: The onboarding tour. Too many screens.

speaker: interviewer
text: Got it. Great. And final question, anything else you want to tell me?

speaker: interviewee
text: No, I think that's it. Good luck with it, seriously, it's a fun idea.

speaker: interviewer
text: Thank you so much Daniel, this was super helpful.

speaker: interviewee
text: Sure thing. Bye.
